digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, V, VI and ch. 4

teaser.en: The 'perfume-root' tree: its roots are recognised by smell, though only by the oldest Digo now.
teaser.sw: Mti wa 'mzizi wa manukato': mizizi yake hutambuliwa kwa harufu, ingawa sasa ni wazee kabisa wa Kidigo tu wanaoijua.

summary.en: Mrandze is a bush tree related to African blackwood, known for its fragrant roots. Pakia found that only elderly Digo still knew how to recognise it.
summary.sw: Mrandze ni mti wa vichakani, jamaa wa mpingo, unaojulikana kwa mizizi yake yenye harufu nzuri. Pakia aligundua kwamba ni wazee wa Kidigo tu waliokuwa bado wanajua kuutambua.

about.en:
*Mrandze* is a small to medium tree of the pea family, in the same genus as *mphingo*, African blackwood. It has compound leaves with many small leaflets, small whitish pea-like flowers in loose sprays, and flat, papery pods with one to a few seeds.

Pakia's informants identified it from its leaves and from the smell of its roots. He describes it as the 'perfume-root' plant, one of the few wild plants that Digo speakers identify from the root.
about.sw:
*Mrandze* ni mti mdogo hadi wa wastani wa jamii ya kunde, katika jenasi ileile ya *mphingo*, yaani mpingo. Una majani mchanganyiko yenye vijani vingi vidogo, maua madogo meupe-meupe yanayofanana na ya kunde katika vishada vilivyolegea, na maganda bapa yaliyo kama karatasi yenye mbegu moja hadi chache.

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa majani yake na kwa harufu ya mizizi yake. Anaueleza kuwa mmea wa 'mzizi wa manukato', mojawapo ya mimea michache ya porini ambayo Wadigo huitambua kwa mzizi.

where.en: It grows in woodland and bushland in eastern and south-eastern Africa, including the bush of the Kenya coast.
where.sw: Unaota katika mapori ya miti na vichaka mashariki na kusini-mashariki mwa Afrika, ikiwemo vichaka vya pwani ya Kenya.

uses.en: The fragrant root was valued for its scent, but Pakia found that this use is no longer practised.
uses.sw: Mzizi wake wenye harufu nzuri ulithaminiwa kwa harufu yake, lakini Pakia aligundua kwamba matumizi haya hayafanyiki tena.

culture.en: Pakia reports that only elderly Digo could recognise *mrandze*, because its uses are no longer practised. It is an example of plant knowledge fading as the uses behind it disappear.
culture.sw: Pakia anaripoti kwamba ni wazee wa Kidigo tu walioweza kuutambua *mrandze*, kwa sababu matumizi yake hayafanyiki tena. Ni mfano wa maarifa ya mimea yanayofifia kadiri matumizi yaliyoyategemeza yanavyotoweka.

names.en: Pakia records *mrandze* and notes that Duruma shares the name. He gives no meaning. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: Pakia anaandika *mrandze* na anabainisha kwamba Kiduruma pia kinatumia jina hili. Hatoi maana yake. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.

reason.en: Millettia, another pea-family tree of the bush
reason.sw: Millettia, mti mwingine wa vichakani wa jamii ya kunde

reason.en: Another plant valued for its scent
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine unaothaminiwa kwa harufu yake
